title: Herbal Tart with Brie and Croation Crostini
description: A refreshing summer tart featuring a brie and herbal filling atop a flaky pastry crust, served with crispy croation crostini.

ingredients.name: fresh herbs
ingredients.notes: chopped (such as parsley, thyme, or rosemary)

instructions: Roll out pastry dough to fit the tart shell.
Place the dough in the tart shell and trim the edges.
Spread the softened brie cheese evenly over the pastry.
Top the brie with chopped fresh herbs.
Brush the edges of the pastry with aerated water.
Bake the tart for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Meanwhile, toast the sliced croatian bread until crispy.
Serve the tart with crispy crostini on the side.
